title: Link directly to selected wiki entries
changes: Add links that restore the dropdown positions of a wiki section in the same generated dataset, including dependent text, sprite and audio selectors.
Encode only control IDs and numeric positions in the query and ignore invalid, disabled or unavailable positions.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-bookmarks-synthetic-pm8g31r3 passed ten Chrome tests covering cascading selection, invalid links and existing controls.
Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-bookmarks-local-f58jm7ej checked nine sections across seven scopes without changing embedded data.
Docker unit rom-data-viewer-bookmarks-docker-16eits0l matched Python on synthetic input; ignored local pages were published with hash guards.
limitations: Links depend on the same generated dataset and do not preserve checkboxes, entered text, canvas choices or playback state. The target volume was unavailable and Windows remains unverified.
